additional_info.subject: RE: ID0443174-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2 / S4 313659082001]Charger is out of service CRM:02681000613
additional_info.body:
Dear
Jagmeet Singh
,
I would like to provide you with an update regarding the ongoing issue.
Upon arrival on-site, the station was found in failsafe mode, which was triggered by multiple restarts without a connection to the SCB. During the night, the station came back online, allowing the failsafe mode to be cleared. A reboot was performed, and the station resumed operation temporarily. However, after restarting, both routers went offline again and were partially unreachable.
We replaced and reconfigured both Router 1 and Router 2 (Teltonika RUT240), but unfortunately, the station could not be brought back online. Without a stable connection to the SCB, the station remains stuck at 30% during the startup process and cannot be restored.
We require further support to resolve this issue. The replacement of the Teltonika routers did not solve the problem.
Thank you in advance for your assistance.
Best regards,
Simon Wirth
Service Technician
